title: You plant it
notes: Recall montage: hard cuts, each verb brings back pictures already seen. QT-2 is held for the whole of 'She was right' (2.1 s) rather than the plan's 0.5 s flash, so the recall pictures start on 'You can't shake it'. Trim to 0.5 s if Kai wants the flash; the bread crowd then starts earlier.

Storyboard (canon) names the yacht among the recalled images; the edit plan does not. It is here as 1.8 s of PH-11A-Y after the 2020 SHAKE card, with LABEL-ILLUSTRATION, and carries the 11a legal check. Drop 13-05/13-06 and extend 13-04 if the legal read says no.
'People have tried' vs Kai's August 'Nobody ever has': ruling owed; the picture does not change.

'There is a magic money tree' is the only line over pure black (2 s).
